diet.text: Frogs and toads; also earthworms, lizards, rodents

overview.text: The Buff Striped Keelback is a common, gentle, non-venomous snake of South and South-east Asia. It looks like an Asian garter snake, but is rarely seen.

size.label: Adults
size.text: Usually 50 to 80 cm; females are longer than males.

distribution.label: Native
distribution.text: From Pakistan, India and Sri Lanka through Nepal, Bangladesh, Myanmar and Indochina to southern China and Taiwan.

behaviour.text: Active by day and mostly on land, but it readily goes into water.

diet.text: Mainly frogs and toads, plus earthworms, small lizards and rodents.

recognise.text: Two light stripes along the body, like a garter snake.
